literal_meaning: অর্থহীন আঁকাবাঁকা রেখা বা অস্পষ্ট লেখা
figurative_meaning_bn: আঁকাবাঁকা রেখাযুক্ত অস্পষ্ট অর্থহীন লেখা; পরস্পরজড়িত অর্থহীন রেখা বা অবোধ্য লেখা
figurative_meaning_en: Crooked lines forming unclear, meaningless writing; intertwined meaningless lines or incomprehensible script
example_sentences_in_english: His notebook is filled with scribbles.
The child is drawing meaningless lines on the paper.
note: This idiom mimics the sound or appearance of tangled, nonsensical writing, commonly used in Bengali to describe poor or meaningless handwriting.
